data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Shadow Xs
levels.description: Extra small shadow with 1px Y offset and 2px blur at 5% black opacity. Provides minimal elevation for subtle UI elements.

levels.name: Shadow Sm
levels.description: Small shadow combining two layers - 6% and 5% black opacity with 2px and 3px blur. Creates light elevation.

levels.name: Shadow
levels.description: Default shadow with two layers at 3% and 5% opacity, 4px and 6px blur with negative spread. Standard elevation level.

levels.name: Shadow Md
levels.description: Medium shadow with 15px and 6px blur at 5% and 3% opacity. Used for moderate elevation.

levels.name: Shadow Xl
levels.description: Extra large shadow with 50px blur and 25% black opacity for high elevation floating elements.

levels.name: Shadow Queue Drawer
levels.description: Drawer shadow with two layers at 4% and 10% opacity, 10px and 25px blur. Used for slide-out panels.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Control Primary
levels.description: Primary overlay control shadow with 3 layers at 6% opacity each. Used for primary interactive controls.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Control Secondary
levels.description: Secondary overlay control shadow with 4 layers including 1px ring at 6% opacity.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Control Outline
levels.description: Outline variant shadow with dark ring at 60% black opacity for strong visual separation.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Control Outline Disabled
levels.description: Disabled state shadow for outlined controls with reduced visual prominence.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Control Ghost
levels.description: Ghost control shadow with subtle 10% black ring for minimal elevation.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Control Ghost Text
levels.description: Text shadow for ghost controls at 45% black opacity with 3px blur.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Control Ghost Icon
levels.description: Icon shadow for ghost controls at 35% black opacity with 2px blur.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Control Ghost Icon Disabled
levels.description: Disabled icon shadow at 25% black opacity with 4px blur.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Checkbox
levels.description: Checkbox shadow with subtle elevation and 20% black ring.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Checkbox Checked
levels.description: Checked checkbox shadow with white ring at 60% opacity for selected state.

levels.name: Shadow Overlay Chip
levels.description: Chip shadow with subtle 5% black ring for tag-like elements.

levels.name: Composer Prompt Shadow
levels.description: Shadow for composer/prompt input areas with medium elevation.

levels.name: Tw Ring Shadow
levels.description: Tailwind ring shadow reset/placeholder with transparent value.
